title: Linear Algebra and Algebraic Geometry: A Matrix Construction for Classifying Families of Algebraic Curves with No Solutions in Z^+
summary: A substantial body of results is known for curves of degree $d=3$, namely elliptic curves, including the theorems of Siegel, Mazur, and Mordell, among others. More generally, Faltings established comprehensive results for all algebraic curves of degree $d \ge 2$. However, these results do not, in general, furnish an explicit or systematic procedure for classifying algebraic curves that fail to admit solutions over a prescribed set such as $\mathbb{Z}^{+}$.
